sloka: ब्राह्मणायोद्यताम् पूजाम् विहन्तु कलुषेन्द्रियः ।बालवत्साम् च गाम् दोग्दु यस्यर्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-५६॥
transliteration: brāhmaṇāyodyatām pūjām vihantu kaluṣendriyaḥ ।bālavatsām ca gām dogdu yasyaryo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-56॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way a person with befouled senses disturbs the offerings of worship kept ready for a brahmin and milks the cow having a young calf acquires.
